anomalies.observed: C13 is valued "0.1mF 50V" (100 µF) but uses a 0603 (C_0603_1608Metric) footprint with a generic X7R 0603 part (CC0603KRX7R9BB104, 0.1 µF). The SPICE deck also models it as 0.1mF across the 3.3 V CAN supply. A 100 µF capacitor cannot be a 0603 part, and the listed MPN is a 0.1 µF part.
anomalies.expected: A 0.1 µF (100 nF) decoupling capacitor, matching the other 0.1 µF decoupling capacitors on the SERIAL_CAN_PWR_3.3V rail (C14, C25, C26, C30, C31), or a correctly sized bulk capacitor in a package that can hold it.

evidence.quote: C13 | 0.1mF 50V | Capacitor_SMD:C_0603_1608Metric | Device:C | Unpolarized capacitor | LCSC=C14663, MPN=CC0603KRX7R9BB104
SERIAL_CAN_PWR_3.3V : C13.2(passive) C14.2(passive) C25.2(passive) C26.2(passive) C30.1(1,passive) C31.1(1,passive)

anomalies.impact: The value label disagrees with the part actually fitted. If the 0.1 µF part is placed, the rail gets less bulk decoupling than the schematic label implies, which can affect the SPI CAN controllers, the SC16IS752 UARTs and the 3.3 V CAN transceiver supply. If a true 100 µF part is intended, the 0603 footprint cannot hold it.

parsed.summary: C13 is labelled 0.1 mF (100 µF) yet sits in a 0603 footprint with a 0.1 µF MPN, so its value is inconsistent with its package and with the other decoupling on the same 3.3 V CAN rail.
